name: 29421-transcribe-whisperturbo-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=50, warmup the first 20% by completion, bounded at 1460 requests with a 900 s safety cap.
workload: OpenAI-shaped speech transcription: one audio clip per request and no text prompt, transcribed to EOS with no `max_tokens` cap at temperature 0. The clips are the 73 of `hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy` (`clean`/`validation`) -- read English, 16 kHz mono -- truncated to 3.0 s and cycled 20 times from a prepared local copy; ten are naturally shorter than 3.0 s and arrive at their own length. The decoder prompt is the fixed prefix `<|startoftranscript|><|en|><|transcribe|><|notimestamps|>` with a newline appended.
purpose: A speech-to-text service transcribing short English audio clips for 50 concurrent callers on a single GPU.
launch:
# Engine: source checkout at commit 90d6cf921fe623524f618740616a6cf494d4a8df
# (git describe: v0.13.0rc1-59-g90d6cf921fe6). The interpreter and the hardware pin live in
# configs/env.yaml.

model: openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own torch_dtype, written down so a future default cannot drift it.
dtype: float16

max-num-batched-tokens: 32768
